landing.title: See how far every patient moves.
landing.lead: Motivance follows movement through a phone camera and counts each repetition against the range you prescribe. You set the target, your patient does the work, and the results reach your desk.
landing.step1Detail: Choose an exercise, drag the arc to the start and target angles, and publish it to your patient.
landing.step2Detail: At home, the phone camera follows the joint and counts each repetition that reaches the target and returns.
landing.step3Detail: Measured range and repetitions arrive here, session by session, so you can adjust the plan.
landing.therapistsDetail: Invite patients, prescribe ranges and your own exercises, and follow progress on a large screen.
landing.administratorsDetail: Manage accounts, care-team links and the exercise catalogue. Every change is confirmed and audited.
landing.patientsDetail: Exercises run in the Motivance mobile app, because they need the phone camera.
landing.privacyTitle: Camera frames stay on the phone.
landing.privacyDetail: Only consented movement summaries are saved. No images, video or landmarks are stored.
landing.notValidated: Development prototype. Movement measurements require professional validation.
landing.demoLabel: A sample skeleton measuring elbow flexion
landing.demoHint: Take the hand and move the arm yourself.

custom.title: New custom exercise
custom.help: Describe the movement and choose the joint the camera measures. Only you can assign this exercise.
custom.name: Exercise name
custom.removeDetail: You can no longer assign it. Patients who already have it keep it, and their results stay in their history.
custom.zeroStraight: 0° is the joint held straight. The angle rises as it bends.
custom.zeroSide: 0° is the arm resting at the side. The angle rises as it lifts.
custom.zeroAnkle: About 90° with the foot flat. The angle rises as the foot lifts toward the shin.
custom.cameraLimit: The camera measures in 2D. The patient needs to stay upright, with the shoulder, hip and this joint in view.

profile.privacyText: Motivance will use your sign-in email, name, username, birthdate, gender, address, contact number and avatar to manage your account and support rehabilitation within this system. Your connected therapist can view these details to understand your patient profile and provide care. Your rehabilitation records are used for session tracking and progress review. We use these data only for these system purposes. You can edit your profile, request a copy or deletion of your data in Profile, and contact your care provider about your consent. Requests require review; they do not immediately erase existing care records. This agreement is separate from consent to record movement summaries. Privacy agreement version: system-purpose-v1.
